title: WHAT IF EVERYONE VANISHED EXCEPT YOU? 🌍😱 (Animated Short Film)
description:
At 2:14 PM on a Tuesday, eight billion human beings vanished into thin air. No war. No bodies. No screams. Just an immediate, suffocating silence.

For the first week, Pip lived like a god: ripping four-million-dollar supercars down empty highways, claiming billionaire penthouses, and eating wagyu steaks. But when the power grid fails, tap water turns black, and wild packs of dogs roam the asphalt, paradise turns into an eighty-billion-ton tomb.

Until Day 365... when three heavy, rhythmic knocks rattle the steel door of his bunker.

═══════════════════════════════════════════
💬 THE ULTIMATE SURVIVAL DILEMMA:
═══════════════════════════════════════════
Someone—or something—is knocking at your locked bunker door:
👉 Option A: "OPEN THE DOOR — Anything is better than living and dying completely alone."
👉 Option B: "BARRICADE IT & HIDE — Whatever survived 8 billion people vanishing is NOT human."

Drop your choice in the comments below! We read and heart every single comment. ❤️
